title: Concept: Credential left in a served comment
description: A comment that contains a password, key or token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The comment is served to every visitor and copied into every cache, so the credential has to be treated as public from the moment the page is deployed.
applicability: Deployments that render a comment that contains a password, key or token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The comment is served to every visitor and copied into every cache, so the credential has to be treated as public from the moment the page is deployed.
